Context
-------
Read .github/copilot-instructions.md first.

Deploys the observability backends into the cluster built by scripts/.
This is the largest single deploy and the one most likely to hide an
outbound network dependency.

Objective
---------
Vendor every Helm chart and write pinned values files so the entire stack
installs with no network access.

Components
----------
  kube-prometheus-stack        Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana
  loki                         single-binary or scalable-single-target
  tempo                        single binary, OTLP ingestion
  pyroscope                    single binary
  opentelemetry-collector      Deployment, OTLP in, fan-out
  fluent-bit                   DaemonSet, tails container logs
  perses                       Deployment, three datasources

All deployed to namespace: observability

Deliverables
------------
- charts/*.tgz              vendored, recorded in versions.lock
- values/*.yaml             one per component
- scripts/30-stack.sh       helm upgrade --install in dependency order
- scripts/31-capture-plugins.sh  download Perses plugins on the build node
- images.txt                every resolved image, written by 30-stack.sh

Key requirements

1. Every image pinned by tag AND digest. scripts/30-stack.sh writes the
   resolved list to images.txt on each run, and that file feeds the
   offline capture step later.

2. Prometheus must scrape Hubble. Add a ServiceMonitor selecting the
   cilium-agent DaemonSet on its hubble-metrics port (9965), keeping the
   hubble_* metric set. Verify the metrics actually appear in a Prometheus
   query before declaring this done.

3. Fluent Bit must:
   - tail /var/log/containers/*.log with the cri multiline parser
   - apply the kubernetes filter for enrichment
   - output to Loki at http://loki-gateway.observability.svc.cluster.local
   - expose its own metrics on :2021
   - include a commented-out [OUTPUT] opentelemetry block. The presenter
     will enable this live to demonstrate that Fluent Bit is an OTLP
     producer. Leave it commented but present and correct.
   - have no output that could attempt an outbound connection

4. OTel Collector:
   receivers:  otlp (grpc 4317, http 4318)
   processors: memory_limiter, batch
   exporters:  otlp/tempo
   exactly one pipeline, traces only. Logs arrive via Fluent Bit.

5. Perses must load Prometheus, Loki and Tempo datasources with no
   outbound plugin fetch. 31-capture-plugins.sh downloads the required
   plugin archives on the build node into bundle/perses-plugins/. The
   Perses deployment mounts that directory from the host.

6. Grafana: no plugin installation at runtime. Provision nothing the demo
   does not use — no starter dashboards, no extra orgs, no anonymous
   access.

Out of scope
------------
Demo application manifests, alert rules, dashboards, chaos objects.

Acceptance
----------
30-stack.sh completes with the VM's network interface down.
`kubectl get pods -n observability` shows everything Running with no
restarts. These all return 200:
  curl localhost:9090/-/ready
  curl localhost:3100/ready
  curl localhost:3200/ready
   curl localhost:8080/api/v1/health   (perses)
Report each response.
